title: 리딩인사이드 스타터 UNIT 01 Origins 문장
source: Reading Inside Starter Answer Key — 구문 해설 인용문 + 워크북 WRITING TEST 정답 청크(해석은 교재 해석 발췌)

grammar.evidence: R1 Check Up: went / came · R2 Check Up: I didn’t eat pizza yesterday. / Did she read the newspaper? · WB GRAMMAR TEST A(met·wrote) B(broke·read·bought·drank) C(Did you enjoy / He didn’t play)

sentences.title: Listen to Your Heart
sentences.en: …, a French doctor named René Laennec went for a walk.
sentences.ko: René Laennec이라는 이름의 프랑스 의사는 산책하러 갔다.

sentences.title: Listen to Your Heart
sentences.en: He saw two boys playing with a hollow stick.
sentences.ko: 그는 두 소년이 속이 빈 막대기를 가지고 놀고 있는 것을 보았다.

sentences.title: Listen to Your Heart
sentences.en: The tube-shaped stick was making the tiny noise very loud!
sentences.ko: 관 형태의 그 막대기가 아주 작은 소리를 매우 크게 만들고 있었다!
sentences.target: making the tiny noise very loud

sentences.title: Listen to Your Heart
sentences.en: He rolled up a piece of paper to make a tube.
sentences.ko: 그는 관을 만들기 위해 종이 한 장을 말았다.

sentences.title: Listen to Your Heart
sentences.en: He was inspired by this idea, so he made a long, wooden tube.
sentences.ko: 그는 이 아이디어에서 영감을 받아, 나무로 된 기다란 관을 만들었다.

sentences.title: Listen to Your Heart
sentences.en: …, and the design has been used ever since.
sentences.ko: 그 디자인은 그 후로 줄곧 사용되어 왔다.

sentences.title: Listen to Your Heart
sentences.en: …, because he thought all doctors should be able to use it for free.
sentences.ko: 모든 의사가 그것을 무료로 사용할 수 있어야 한다고 생각했기 때문이다.
sentences.point: should+be able to: ~할 수 있어야 한다

sentences.title: The Amazing Cajon
sentences.en: …, and players sit on it and play it with their hands!
sentences.ko: 연주자들은 그 위에 앉아 손으로 그것을 연주한다!
sentences.target: sit on it and play it

sentences.title: The Amazing Cajon
sentences.en: …, many West Africans were captured and brought to the Americas.

sentences.title: The Amazing Cajon
sentences.en: Did this stop them from drumming?
sentences.ko: 이것이 그들로 하여금 드럼을 연주하는 것을 막았을까?

sentences.title: The Amazing Cajon
sentences.en: They had plenty of old shipping crates, so they decided to play the crates like drums.
sentences.ko: 그들은 오래된 해상 운송 상자를 많이 가지고 있어서, 그 상자들을 드럼처럼 연주하기로 했다.

sentences.title: The Amazing Cajon
sentences.en: Later, the cajon became popular among Spanish flamenco players and eventually spread to jazz, blues, and rock.
sentences.ko: 후에, 카혼은 스페인 플라멩코 연주자들 사이에서 인기를 얻었고 결국 재즈, 블루스, 그리고 록으로 퍼졌다.

sentences.title: The Amazing Cajon
sentences.ko: 그들은 더는 드럼을 갖고 있지 않았다

quiz.q: In 1816, René Laennec ____ for a walk. (go)
Then he ____ up a piece of paper. (roll)
Yesterday, the boys ____ a hollow stick. (find)
In 1852, George Cammann ____ a metal stethoscope. (make)
The slaves (didn’t have / didn’t had) drums anymore.
(Did / Do) she read the newspaper yesterday?
Did you enjoyed the concert last night?
quiz.a: Did you enjoy the concert last night?

quiz.q: He doesn’t play the cajon yesterday.
quiz.a: He didn’t play the cajon yesterday.
